input: Write a short biography for my memoir class

gold.taskTitle: Write a Short Biography for Memoir Class
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to write a short biography to fulfill a requirement or assignment for their memoir class.

questions.title: Who is the biography actually about?
questions.description: Is this a biography about yourself (autobiographical) or about another person?

questions.title: What word count or page length is required?
questions.description: Does the class specify a minimum or maximum length for the biography?

questions.title: What is the submission deadline for this assignment?
questions.description: When does the completed biography need to be turned in?

questions.title: What specific time period of life should it cover?
questions.description: Should it cover an entire life, a single chapter, or a defining moment or era?

questions.title: Has your instructor given a specific prompt or theme?
questions.description: Is there a guiding question, theme, or angle the biography must address?

questions.title: What tone or style is expected for this class?
questions.description: Should the writing be formal and academic, or personal and narrative in style?

questions.title: Do you have existing notes, drafts, or source material?
questions.description: Is there already written material, outlines, or research you want to build from?
